newsHighlights.title: Railway travel demand spikes as nearly 100 million tickets are sold
newsHighlights.summary: Railway travel demand has surged ahead of the holiday season, with nearly 100 million tickets sold, signaling robust consumer spending on services.
newsHighlights.translation: 铁路出行需求激增，已售出近一亿张车票，显示出服务消费的强劲势头。

newsHighlights.title: Global hopes for economic stability hinge on Xi's visit
newsHighlights.summary: Global hopes for stability hinge on the upcoming visit, as markets and businesses seek clearer signals on trade and investment.
newsHighlights.translation: 全球对稳定的期盼取决于此次访问，因为市场和企业都在寻求有关贸易与投资的更明确信号。

newsHighlights.title: Build guardrails for China-US competition
newsHighlights.summary: Analysts urge both sides to build guardrails for China-US competition so that economic rivalry does not spill over into damaging trade conflict.
newsHighlights.translation: 分析人士呼吁双方为中美竞争设置护栏，使经济博弈不至于演变为破坏性的贸易冲突。

newsHighlights.title: US-China climate cooperation matters a lot for green investment
newsHighlights.summary: Climate change knows no borders, and experts say US-China cooperation on emissions is crucial for green industries and long-term growth.
newsHighlights.translation: 气候变化无国界，专家表示，中美在减排方面的合作对绿色产业和长期增长至关重要。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's visit 'plants seeds' for next generation of US-China ties
newsHighlights.summary: The visit is seen as planting seeds for the next generation of US-China ties, boosting business prospects across sectors.
newsHighlights.translation: 此访被视为为下一代中美关系播下种子，有望提振各行业的商业前景。

quote.quote: The best time to plant a tree was twenty years ago. The second best time is now.
quote.author: Chinese Proverb
quote.translation: 种一棵树最好的时间是二十年前，其次是现在。
quote.explanation: 投资、贸易关系和人才培养都是长期工程。正如新闻所说，此次访问为下一代中美关系「播下种子」——商业合作的回报需要耐心，但行动永远不嫌晚。

vocabulary.example: Railway travel demand spikes as nearly 100 million tickets are sold before the holiday.
vocabulary.translation: 假期前售出近一亿张车票，铁路出行需求急剧上升。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Railway travel demand spikes, nearly 100m tickets sold」。

vocabulary.definition: 需求；（市场的）购买欲望与支付能力
vocabulary.example: Strong consumer demand for travel has boosted the service sector this quarter.
vocabulary.translation: 强劲的旅游消费需求在本季度提振了服务业。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Railway travel demand spikes」中的 demand 一词。

vocabulary.definition: 稳定性；（经济、市场的）平稳
vocabulary.example: Investors value economic stability because it lowers the risk of doing business.
vocabulary.translation: 投资者看重经济稳定，因为它能降低经商风险。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Global hopes for stability hinge on visit」。

vocabulary.example: Global hopes for stability hinge on the outcome of the high-level visit.
vocabulary.translation: 全球对稳定的期盼取决于此次高层访问的结果。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Global hopes for stability hinge on visit」。

vocabulary.definition: 护栏；（喻）防止失控的保障机制
vocabulary.example: Both economies need guardrails to keep competition from turning into a trade war.
vocabulary.translation: 两大经济体需要护栏机制，以免竞争演变为贸易战。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Build guardrails for China-US competition」。

vocabulary.example: Fair competition pushes companies to innovate and cut costs.
vocabulary.translation: 公平竞争促使企业创新并降低成本。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Build guardrails for China-US competition」中的核心词 competition。

vocabulary.example: US-China climate cooperation matters a lot for green businesses worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 中美气候合作对全球绿色企业至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「US-China climate cooperation matters a lot」。

vocabulary.example: Tighter emission rules are creating a fast-growing market for clean technology.
vocabulary.translation: 更严格的排放法规正在催生快速增长的清洁技术市场。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻「Emissions from one country affect the entire planet」中的 emissions。

vocabulary.definition: 前景；（常用复数）预期、可能性
vocabulary.example: The visit is expected to boost trade prospects for exporters in both countries.
vocabulary.translation: 此次访问有望提振两国出口商的贸易前景。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Xi's visit to boost prospects of ties」。

vocabulary.example: Constructive dialogue gives businesses the confidence to sign long-term deals.
vocabulary.translation: 建设性对话让企业有信心签署长期合约。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自新闻标题「Why 'constructive strategic stability' matters for China-US relations」。

pattern.pattern: no ... can go it alone（没有任何……能独自应对）
pattern.example: Emissions from one country affect the entire planet, and no nation can go it alone.
pattern.translation: 一个国家的排放会影响整个地球，没有任何国家能独自应对。
pattern.usage: 用于说明某问题跨越边界、必须合作解决。go it alone 意为「单干、独自应对」。可替换 no nation 为 no company / no economy / no investor 等，例如：No company can go it alone in the global supply chain.

grammar.title: 主谓一致：单数主语 vs. 复数主语（Subject-Verb Agreement）
grammar.explanation: 谓语动词的单复数必须与主语一致。当主语是复数名词时，谓语用原形；当主语是单数或不可数名词（如 stability, demand, cooperation）时，一般现在时第三人称用 -s/-es 形式。新闻标题「Global hopes for stability hinge on visit」中，主语 hopes 是复数，所以用 hinge；若改为单数 hope，就要用 hinges。修饰语（如 for stability）不影响谓语单复数。
examples: Global hopes for stability hinge on the outcome of the visit.（hopes 复数 → hinge）
US-China climate cooperation matters a lot.（cooperation 单数 → matters）

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -bil- 上，首音节中的 a 弱读为 /ə/，不要读成 /stæ-/。整词四个音节：stə-BIL-i-ty，末尾的 -ty 要读得轻快。同类词还有 ability、economy。
examples: Global hopes for stability hinge on the visit.

reading.title: Holiday Rush Signals Stronger Consumer Demand
reading.content:
As the holiday season approaches, China's railways have sold nearly 100 million tickets, and travel demand has spiked far beyond last year's level. Economists say the surge reflects stronger consumer demand for services, from transport to hotels and catering. Service spending now accounts for a growing share of household budgets, and rail operators are adding trains to keep up.

At the same time, global hopes for economic stability hinge on the high-level visit between Chinese and US leaders. Analysts argue that both sides should build guardrails for their competition so that business rivalry does not damage trade. Constructive dialogue, they say, could boost prospects for exporters, investors and green industries. Climate cooperation also matters a lot for business: tighter emission rules are opening a large market for clean technology.

In short, no economy can go it alone in today's interconnected market. Whether it is a train ticket or a trade deal, growth depends on trust, openness and steady demand.
reading.translation:
随着假期临近，中国铁路已售出近一亿张车票，出行需求远超去年同期水平。经济学家表示，这一激增反映出服务消费需求走强，涵盖交通、酒店与餐饮等领域。服务性支出在家庭预算中的占比不断提高，铁路运营方正加开列车以满足需求。

与此同时，全球对经济稳定的期盼取决于中美高层会晤。分析人士认为，双方应为彼此竞争设置护栏，使商业博弈不至于损害贸易。他们表示，建设性对话有望改善出口商、投资者和绿色产业的前景。气候合作对企业同样意义重大：更严格的排放法规正在打开庞大的清洁技术市场。

简言之，在当今互联互通的市场中，没有哪个经济体能独自应对挑战。无论是一张车票还是一份贸易协议，增长都依赖于信任、开放和稳定的需求。
reading.sourceNote: 改写自 China Daily《Railway travel demand spikes, nearly 100m tickets sold》《Global hopes for stability hinge on visit》《Build guardrails for China-US competition》《US-China climate cooperation matters a lot》及 CGTN 相关报道，为英语学习目的进行了语言简化与整合。
